name: Highcharts Stock Charts
description: Adds Highcharts Stock (Highstock) as a rendering library option for the Charts module.
project_description:
This is a module that integrates the Highcharts® Stock charting library from Highcharts® with the Charts module. It was formerly called Highstock, and that shows up in the code.

 This library requires a license! You can purchase one here: https://shop.highcharts.com/ 

 If you are wanting to use this module with Views, be sure to use the Highstock Value Field, which needs a "timestamp provider" field and a "value provider" field to be present in the views fields. Then, the Highstock Value Field is what you would use as your "data provider" in the Chart settings.

 This module was developed on a site that uses both the Highcharts (charts_highcharts) and this module on the same page. For that reason, we needed to do a little bit of Javascript library acrobatics to avoid errors; this shouldn't be an issue, but just letting you know if you notice the libraries file looking a little strange.
